findings: Verified: npm run map:test (12 files, 53 tests pass; includes tsc -p MAP/tsconfig.tools.json) and npm run build (0 errors). Nothing committed. Deps pinned: vitest 5.0.4, @types/node 24.19.2, playwright 1.64.0 (no browser download). map:nodes is `node MAP/tools/map-nodes.mjs` (sets MAP_REGEN=1 and runs MAP/tests/generate-nodes.regen.test.ts; cmd-safe). vitest config sets fileParallelism:false so the 135x135 walkpath timing (<100ms) is not skewed. Node generation needed NO waypoint adjustment: K1 hops 90.8 (L10-L11) .. 198.2 (A-B), bridge hops L3-L4 246.3 and L8-L9 206.6 tagged hop:'bridge' on the arriving node (L4, L9); K2/K3 spacing within 95-195; gates/entrances match the DESIGN 3.2 table exactly. K1 anchors were used as given in the design (L9 nudged to 1266,364); the +/-4 px re-measurement on the PNG and footprint re-measure were NOT done (left for FEAT-003 step 10, data/scenes/k1.ts K1_S1_FOOTPRINTS holds the design table values). K1_LEVEL45_U lever in data/spines.ts is unused (5650). For later steps: (1) MAP/src/core/layout.ts computeLayout() is the source for nodes/gates/entrances and dense per-kingdom paths (KingdomPath with cum, nodeArc, frontArc, gateFront); spines in MAP/data/spines.ts (waypoints + fixed/pinned nodes); (2) walkPath.computeWalkPath returns shared read-only Pt objects, segments<=60; walkPlan(from,to?) ends at the gate front (K1/K2) or L45 (K3), warpAfterIndex marks the teleport; the next-kingdom re-spawn is not part of the plan; (3) flow/flowAdapter getStepRef returns avatar standing position y = node.y - blockH/2 + 10 (legacy formula) plus blockH; computeWalkPath/buildTransitionPlan shift polylines by that offset and snap ends to the step refs; buildTransitionPlan(from,q,to) returns {fromStep,toStep,path,warpAfterIndex}; (4) api/types.ts MapFlowOptions.mapPhase is string; MapRenderer is satisfied by Game2DMapRenderer (tests/types.test-d.ts compiles under map:test); (5) status.deriveStatuses/avatarNode take optional nodes param (default NODES); (6) core/camera.ts also exports followTarget, glideAt, shouldWarp, defaultZoom, KINGDOM_TRAVEL_MS; (7) core/quality.ts exports detectQuality(info) and detectQualityFromNavigator (deviceMemory<=4 caps at medium via the same thresholds); (8) MAP/demo/main.ts is an empty stub (export {}), MAP/src/index.ts is `export {}`; MAP/demo/vite.config.mjs does not exist yet (map:demo script will fail until FEAT for step 8).
